components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action in a form or panel (save rule, apply).

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: Segmented Period Control

components.name: Text Input

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Rail navigation; current page is a white pill with accent text.

components.name: Summary Strip
components.description: One panel of four figures divided by hairlines, each with a neutral delta and trend arrow.
components.html:
Uscite12.480,00 €−15,7% vs periodo prec.
Entrate15.200,00 €−31,2% vs periodo prec.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding:20px 24px; background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--radius-l); box-shadow:var(--shadow); font-family: var(--font-sans); color:var(--text); } .ds-summary { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); } .ds-figure { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; padding:0 24px; border-left:1px solid var(--border); } .ds-figure:first-child { padding-left:0; border-left:0; } .ds-figure-label { color:var(--text-2); font-size:var(--fs-s); font-weight:550; } .ds-figure-main .ds-figure-label { color:var(--accent-text); } .ds-figure-value { font-size:var(--fs-2xl); font-weight:650; letter-spacing:-0.01em; line-height:1.25; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-delta { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; color:var(--text-2); font-size:var(--fs-s); font-weight:550; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-delta-ref { color:var(--text-3); font-weight:450; }

components.name: Ranked Category Row
components.description: Signature breakdown row: swatch, name, amount, category-coloured bar, metadata and neutral delta; drills into transactions.
components.css: .ds-rank-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap:6px 12px; width:320px; padding:8px; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius); background:transparent; color:var(--text); text-align:left; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size:var(--fs-m); cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-rank-row:hover { background:var(--surface-2); } .ds-rank-row:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:var(--focus-ring); } .ds-rank-name { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-weight:550; } .ds-swatch { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:3px; background:var(--swatch); } .ds-rank-amount { font-weight:600; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; text-align:right; } .ds-rank-bar { grid-column:1 / -1; height:6px; border-radius:3px; background:var(--grid); overflow:hidden; } .ds-rank-bar > span { display:block; height:100%; border-radius:3px; background:var(--swatch); } .ds-rank-meta { color:var(--text-3); font-size:var(--fs-xs); } .ds-rank-delta { justify-self:end; color:var(--text-2); }

narrative.overview:
Spese is the finance-tool category standard played straight: a calm, dense operating surface in the lineage of Revolut and YNAB, where the period filter scopes everything and the numbers are the interface. Cool-neutral grounds, white panels with hairline borders, one deep teal-blue accent for selection and primary action, and a fixed, validated categorical palette that follows each category everywhere it appears.

Density is deliberate. Body text sits at 14px, labels and metadata at 13px and 12px, and every amount uses tabular numerals so columns align. Hierarchy comes from weight (450 / 550 / 650 on the system sans) and from three steps of text grey, never from decoration. The light scheme is the reference; a dark scheme follows the OS appearance automatically, with surfaces, accent and chart series re-stepped for the dark ground (confirmed by the owner).

The system refuses decoration, mosaics of identical KPI tiles, and gimmick charts. The summary is one panel divided by hairlines, the time series is a plain stacked bar chart, and the category breakdown is a ranked list with thin bars.
keyCharacteristics: One system sans, tabular numerals wherever money appears.
One accent (deep teal-blue) for selection, focus and primary action only.
Category colour is bound to the category, not to its rank in the current period.
Deltas are neutral grey; a trend arrow carries direction.
Flat white panels on a cool-grey ground, one soft shadow level plus one pop level.
Dark scheme follows `prefers-color-scheme`; light is the reference.

rules.name: The Bound Colour Rule
rules.body: A category's colour is assigned from its all-time rank and never changes with the selected period. Charts, legends, swatches and rank bars all read the same `--series-*` variable.

rules.name: The Neutral Delta Rule
rules.body: Period-over-period changes are grey text with a trend-up or trend-down arrow. Colour never judges a delta; red and green stay reserved for money direction and errors.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal-blue marks selection, focus and the primary action. It is never a decorative fill, a chart series, or a heading colour.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every amount, date input and delta renders with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`; numeric columns align right.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Within a panel, hierarchy is weight and grey step, not size jumps. Three text greys and three weights carry it.

rules.name: The Two-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces use the resting shadow; only floating layers use pop. No third level.

dos: **Do** read every colour, including chart colours, from the CSS custom properties so both schemes stay in sync.
**Do** use tabular numerals and right alignment for every amount.
**Do** show period comparisons as grey text with a trend arrow and "vs periodo prec.".
**Do** assign category colours from the fixed seven-slot order and group the rest as "Altre categorie" in series-other.
**Do** separate figures inside one panel with hairlines rather than splitting them into cards.
**Do** use 8px corners for controls and 12px for panels; 1px hairlines for every stroke.
**Do** use Lucide-style stroked SVG icons inline, one style across the interface.
**Do** step every new colour for the dark scheme inside the `prefers-color-scheme: dark` block.
donts: **Don't** colour deltas red or green; the arrow carries direction.
**Don't** use the accent as a chart series, decorative fill or heading colour.
**Don't** build rows of identical KPI tiles.
**Don't** add decorative or gimmick chart types (gauges, 3D); bars and ranked lists carry the data.
**Don't** introduce a third shadow level or hard offset shadows.
